metadata.summary: Arcisstraße 21 is a four-level building (Basement 1, Ground floor, Floor 1, Floor 2) with about 9,853 m² of mapped area across 239 spaces, 169 of which are rooms. Most space is generic rooms, plus corridors and stairwells, and a small lobby on the ground floor. It holds 663 mapped assets, mostly chairs, desks and shelves, along with fire extinguishers and one defibrillator. There are seven staircases and no lift. The building has a step-free entrance, with step-free coverage of 0.77.

floors.name: Ground floor

floors.name: Floor 1
